Fort Worth District Corps of Engineers
P. O. Box 17300
Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Johnson:
This letter is in answer to your request for information concerning the environmental impact of two additional generators at Amistad Lake. Environmental considerations would concern primarily dust generated at the construction site.
If there is any land clearing at the site, outdoor burning of brush should be done in accordance with Regulation I, Rule 101.26 of the Texas Air Control Board.
Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention. If we can assist further, please contact me.
Sincerely yours,
Ball Stewart, P.E.
Deputy Director
Control and Prevention
cc: Mr. Jim Menke, Regional Supervisor, San Antonio
